Subject: Vacancy Circular No. Ol of 2025/RR dated 25.04.2025,
and Advertisement Nos. 02 of 2025/RR, Q3 of
2025/RR, 04 of 2025/RR and OS of 2025/RR dated
25.04.2025.
It is notified for all the concerned, who had responded to
the aforementioned vacancy circular as also the advertisement
notifications, referred to above, that in view oF the judgment dated
21.05.2025, passed by the Hon’ble Apex Court in Civil Appeal No.
9982 of 2024, arising out of SLP (C) No. 25612 of 2023, Ganesh
Kumar Rajeshwarrao Selukar and Ors Vs. Mahendra Bhaskar
Limaye and Ors., and connected matters, the aforementioned
vacancy circular as also the advertisement notifications shall stand
withdrawn.
So far as the application fee in the shape of demand
draft of Rs. 1000/-, which was required to be deposited along with
the application form, is concerned, all the concerned are informed
that they may encash the said amount deposited in the shape of
demand draft from the concerned bank.
h&r.'.,.(Satinder Sindh)
